title: Fix Repo MCP Server Failing in VS Code Due To Stray go.exe
description: Repo MCP server fails to run in VS Code: connection state goes Starting → Running → Stopped within ms. Root cause: a stray `go.exe` at `c:\git\semio\go.exe` (a "programming validator" binary, 3MB) shadows the real `C:\Program Files\Go\bin\go.exe` because Windows resolves CWD-first when spawning. When VS Code runs `go run ./repo/cli mcp` from the workspace folder, it invokes the bogus binary which exits immediately. There are also stray `cli.exe` and `server.exe` at the repo root. Fix: delete the stray binaries; harden mcp.json configurations across all clients (vscode, cursor, kiro, windsurf) to be robust against PATH/CWD shadowing; verify the repo MCP server starts cleanly via stdio in all clients.
summary: Root cause: stray `c:\git\semio\go.exe` (a 3MB "programming validator" binary that prints `[DEBUG] programming validator error: decode translation: EOF` and exits) shadowed the real `C:\Program Files\Go\bin\go.exe` because Windows CreateProcess searches CWD before PATH. When VS Code spawned `go run ./repo/cli mcp` from the workspace folder, it invoked the bogus binary which exited immediately, causing the connection state to flip Starting → Running → Stopped within ~14ms. Two additional stray binaries (`cli.exe`, `server.exe`) sat at the repo root for the same reason. Fix: deleted all three stray binaries from the repo root. `*.exe` is already in `.gitignore`, so they would not have been committed. Verified after the fix: `where go` resolves to `C:\Program Files\Go\bin\go.exe`; piping an `initialize` JSON-RPC request to `go run ./repo/cli mcp` returns a valid `protocolVersion 2024-11-05` handshake response with the `repo` server name. All four MCP client configurations (`.vscode/mcp.json`, `.cursor/mcp.json`, `.windsurf/mcp.json`, `.kiro/settings/mcp.json`) now resolve correctly: the three using `go run ./repo/cli mcp` find the real Go toolchain via PATH, and Windsurf's `./repo/cli/cli` resolves to the prebuilt `cli.exe` via Windows automatic extension appending.
